+"""Standalone variant of :func:`click.command` that keeps name suffixes.
+
+This module does not import Click, so it stays importable in environments
+where Click is not installed. The command class is passed in explicitly.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+_AnyCallable = t.Callable[..., t.Any]
+_CommandFactory = t.Callable[..., t.Any]
+
+
+def command_keep_suffix(
+    Command: type[t.Any],
+    name: str | _AnyCallable | None = None,
+    cls: _CommandFactory | None = None,
+    **attrs: t.Any,
+) -> t.Any:
+    r"""Create a new command using the decorated function as callback, like
+    :func:`click.command`. All decorated options and arguments are attached
+    as parameters to the command.
+
+    The name of the command defaults to the name of the function, converted
+    to lowercase, with underscores ``_`` replaced by dashes ``-``. Unlike
+    :func:`click.command`, the suffixes ``_command``, ``_cmd``, ``_group``,
+    and ``_grp`` are kept. For example, ``init_data_command`` becomes
+    ``init-data-command``.
+
+    All keyword arguments are forwarded to the underlying command class.
+    For the ``params`` argument, any decorated params are appended to the
+    end of the list.
+
+    :param Command: The default command class to create, also used to detect
+        a callback that was already converted into a command.
+    :param name: The name of the command. Defaults to modifying the
+        function's name as described above.
+    :param cls: The command class to create. Defaults to ``Command``.
+    """
+    func: _AnyCallable | None = None
+
+    if callable(name):
+        func = name
+        name = None
+        assert cls is None, "Use 'command(cls=cls)(callable)' to specify a class."
+        assert not attrs, "Use 'command(**kwargs)(callable)' to provide arguments."
+
+    if cls is None:
+        cls = Command
+
+    def decorator(f: _AnyCallable) -> t.Any:
+        if isinstance(f, Command):
+            raise TypeError("Attempted to convert a callback into a command twice.")
+
+        attr_params = attrs.pop("params", None)
+        params = attr_params if attr_params is not None else []
+
+        try:
+            decorator_params = f.__click_params__  # type: ignore
+        except AttributeError:
+            pass
+        else:
+            del f.__click_params__  # type: ignore
+            params.extend(reversed(decorator_params))
+
+        if attrs.get("help") is None:
+            attrs["help"] = f.__doc__
+
+        if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
+            assert cls is not None
+            assert not callable(name)
+
+        if name is not None:
+            cmd_name = name
+        else:
+            cmd_name = f.__name__.lower().replace("_", "-")
+
+        cmd = cls(name=cmd_name, callback=f, params=params, **attrs)
+        cmd.__doc__ = f.__doc__
+        return cmd
+
+    if func is not None:
+        return decorator(func)
+
+    return decorator
diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_command_keep_suffix.py b/tests/test_standalone_command_keep_suffix.py

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_standalone_command_keep_suffix.py
@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+import importlib.util
+import pathlib
+
+import pytest
+
+import click
+import click.testing
+
+_path = (
+    pathlib.Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_command_keep_suffix.py"
+)
+_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("standalone_command_keep_suffix", _path)
+_mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
+_spec.loader.exec_module(_mod)
+command_keep_suffix = _mod.command_keep_suffix
+
+
+def test_module_does_not_import_click():
+    source = _path.read_text()
+    assert "import click" not in source
+    assert "from click" not in source
+
+
+def test_bare_decorator():
+    def cli():
+        """Help text."""
+
+    cmd = command_keep_suffix(click.Command, cli)
+    assert isinstance(cmd, click.Command)
+    assert cmd.name == "cli"
+    assert cmd.help == "Help text."
+    assert cmd.__doc__ == "Help text."
+    assert cmd.callback is cli
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("func_name", "expect"),
+    [
+        ("init_data_command", "init-data-command"),
+        ("init_data_cmd", "init-data-cmd"),
+        ("init_data_group", "init-data-group"),
+        ("init_data_grp", "init-data-grp"),
+        ("Init_Data", "init-data"),
+        ("command", "command"),
+        ("_command", "-command"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_keeps_suffix(func_name, expect):
+    def f():
+        pass
+
+    f.__name__ = func_name
+    assert command_keep_suffix(click.Command)(f).name == expect
+
+
+def test_explicit_name_and_empty_name():
+    def f():
+        pass
+
+    assert command_keep_suffix(click.Command, "other_cmd")(f).name == "other_cmd"
+
+    def g():
+        pass
+
+    assert command_keep_suffix(click.Command, "")(g).name == ""
+
+
+def test_cls_override_and_attrs():
+    class Custom(click.Command):
+        pass
+
+    def f():
+        """Doc."""
+
+    cmd = command_keep_suffix(click.Command, None, Custom, help="Given", hidden=True)(f)
+    assert type(cmd) is Custom
+    assert cmd.help == "Given"
+    assert cmd.hidden
+    assert cmd.__doc__ == "Doc."
+
+    cmd2 = command_keep_suffix(click.Command, cls=Custom)(lambda: None)
+    assert type(cmd2) is Custom
+
+
+def test_params_extracted_and_reversed():
+    @click.option("--a")
+    @click.option("--b")
+    def f(a, b):
+        pass
+
+    cmd = command_keep_suffix(click.Command, params=[click.Option(["--c"])])(f)
+    assert [p.name for p in cmd.params] == ["c", "a", "b"]
+    assert not hasattr(f, "__click_params__")
+
+
+def test_double_conversion():
+    cmd = command_keep_suffix(click.Command, lambda: None)
+
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="twice"):
+        command_keep_suffix(click.Command)(cmd)
+
+
+def test_bare_with_args_asserts():
+    def f():
+        pass
+
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        command_keep_suffix(click.Command, f, click.Command)
+
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        command_keep_suffix(click.Command, f, help="x")
+
+
+def test_invoke():
+    @click.argument("x")
+    def show_cmd(x):
+        click.echo(x)
+
+    cmd = command_keep_suffix(click.Command, show_cmd)
+    result = click.testing.CliRunner().invoke(cmd, ["hi"])
+    assert result.output == "hi\n"
notes:
Copied click.decorators.command control flow into a click-free module taking the Command class as an injected first argument (default constructor and isinstance target), removing only the suffix-stripping step. Tests load the module by file path and cover bare/configured forms, cls override, params ordering, help/doc, double conversion, and kept suffixes.
